rules: These are genuine native screenshots, not reconstructed UI.
Live figures and screenshot receipt visible_text can differ because prices refresh between pixel capture and accessibility extraction. Alt text describes the pixels without quoting volatile figures.
Keep the dark and light variants separate; do not crossfade captures from different app versions.
All new portfolio images use the app's visible Demo state; captions must identify Demo data.
No simulator was booted and no app build or install was needed for this website refresh.

excluded_build67_candidates.reason: Shows AI consent sheet, not a completed conversation.
